maria: Postmortem follow-up: pattern observed across multiple events -> cloud transient -> auth token surge -> model-registry timeouts -> user errors. Need clear owners, deadlines, and a monthly check-in. Who can take the remediation tracker? :mag:
aj: I can own the tracker and do owner rotations. I'll make a simple sheet with owner, priority, status, SLA mapping. Can someone export the last 90 days of incidents by vendor?
liam: I'll pull alerts/logs and build a vendor-week heatmap (will include deploy markers). ETA EOD today.
sre_lead: Also audit circuit-breaker thresholds and autoscaler backoff; retries may be amplifying failures. Add a "failure_mode" column and short-term mitigations.
kate: I'll compare runbooks to what happened and propose quick patches (token jitter handling, cross-region retry). Draft by Tue.
security: I'll check KMS rotations and token TTLs; if rotations are aligned they could cause auth spikes. Recommend adding jitter. Report Monday.
oncall-bot: Linked INC-2026-0413-07; created tracker DEC-2026-0413-01 assigned to AJ.
maria: Thanks. Two asks: add the postmortem link in the tracker and mark infra fallback items as blockers. Scheduling Wed 09:00 sync to review heatmap and tracker. Leave updates in this thread.
